catalog.title: Is WoW Forever Hiding a New LEGENDARY Sword?
catalog.description:
In episode 6 of the official WoW Forever podcast, the board behind Aggrend reads "Shen'serrar lezal melor'na adala fal". Players translated most of it from Darnassian: shen means hidden, serrar is read as blade like in Quel'Serrar, and the last words match the elven saying "the truth is a guiding light". Only lezal has no known translation. Blizzard has not explained the message.

Wowhead's WoW Forever database already lists Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying, the book that started the Quel'Serrar quest chain in Classic, but the sword itself is not in the data as of November 4, 2026.
